tests.title: parses extrastereo options with native shorthand order and refuses everything else with exact messages
pins packed flt for every input format and plans one frame-producing stage without count changes
refuses every layout native would remix, including a masked two-channel WAV layout
matches the C transcription per sample for every m and clip setting, including zeros, opposite signs and subnormals
produces frame-split invariant owned output from integer and float frames without mutating inputs
matches native extrastereo bytes for stereo sources, every m and clip setting, raw, WAV and framecrc outputs (Linux x64 unfused float)
matches native extrastereo framecrc in composed chains, frame splits, defaults and output time selection (Linux x64 unfused float)
refuses layouts native would remix and unimplemented options before output, recording native status

details: 360 byte comparisons (linux/x64): stereo u8/s16le/s32le/f32le/f64le sources x m {-10,-1,0,1,2.5,10} x c {0,1} x outputs raw f32le, raw s16le, WAV pcm_f32le, WAV pcm_s16le, framecrc pcm_f32le, framecrc pcm_s16le; -cpuflags 0; inputs include zero, negative-zero, opposite-sign, equal and +-1.5 pairs

200 framecrc comparisons (linux/x64): s16le/f32le sources x 10 chains (defaults, shorthand, asetnsamples before/after and n=1, chained extrastereo, apad, anull, asetrate) x 5 output selections (none, -ss, -t, -frames:a, -ss+-t) x pcm_f32le/pcm_s16le
13 native exit statuses for refusals: mono and 3-channel input (native 0, implicit remix), 6 forms native rejects, 5 forms native accepts but are unimplemented; no output file is created

unsupported: Non-stereo layouts and non-default two-channel WAV/W64 masks (native remixes implicitly)
Runtime commands (process_command); no command filter exists
m expressions and constants (only decimal literals)
Boolean spellings other than 0, 1, true, false for c
Non-finite input samples; NaN output with c=0 (overflowing finite float input)
Fused-float platforms: float comparisons skip outside linux/x64 (no fused profile implemented)

notes: Setup durations: git submodule update 48 s, npm ci 9 s, npm run reference:build 206 s.
No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
The differential comparison tests skip outside linux/x64 (darwin needs a fused-multiply-add profile, which is not implemented). The refusal test runs on every platform.
Native WAV references are written to a seekable file, because WAV written to a pipe keeps unpatched header sizes.
Sensitivity check: replacing the rounded product with average+m*(l-average) in double made both comparison tests fail.
The masked two-channel layout refusal is covered through validateInputFormat with native layout names; no masked-WAV CLI file test is committed for this filter.
